characters.name: Elena Marini
characters.description: A 29-year-old barista back in Marina di Brenta. Easy at the counter; honest only in the café book.
relationships: Knows Pietro as the Tuesday driver

voice.speakingStyle: adult Italian female, warm at the counter, careful when honest

characters.name: Pietro Baldo
characters.description: A 32-year-old coffee-roaster driver who delivers on Tuesdays. Writes the truth in the book; stutters when it matters aloud.

voice.speakingStyle: adult Italian male, quiet, hesitant when feelings are real

characters.name: Bruna
characters.description: Owner of Caffè Brenta, 58. The book was her idea; almost a shrine to how shy people stay connected.

voice.speakingStyle: middle-aged Italian female, firm, briefly soft

characters.name: Katia
characters.description: Other barista, 26. Sees everything, says little. Has never written in the book.

voice.speakingStyle: young adult Italian female, dry, observant

characters.name: Mirella Marini
characters.description: Elena's mother. Wants Elena to stay. Remembers that Elena's father spoke better on paper.

voice.speakingStyle: middle-aged Italian female, practical, a little insistent

characters.name: Sergio Baldo
characters.description: Pietro's brother. After an accident he is in recovery; pressure on Pietro, not a death plot.
